name: Material Painter (PBR texture painter)
summary: Free, open-source desktop PBR texture painter (Rust + wgpu) for game and film assets. Paint layers, smart materials and masks on 3D models, bake mesh maps (AO, curvature, thickness), build tiling materials in a node graph with custom WGSL nodes, and add weathering bakes (rain streaks, rust, snow, grime). Opens Substance 3D Painter projects, ships ~2,900 CC0 materials from Poly Haven and ambientCG, export presets for Unreal, Unity, Godot, glTF, Roblox, Blender.

access.notes: App code GPL-3.0 (copyleft if you redistribute modified builds); bundled Poly Haven/ambientCG materials are CC0. Textures you paint are yours. Early release (v0.1.x).

procedure: Open the GitHub Releases page (latest is v0.1.5, 2026-11-04).
Download the Windows installer/zip, the Linux x64 tar.gz or the macOS universal dmg.
Unpack/install and run; Windows 10/11 64-bit or Linux x64 (glibc 2.35+).
Optionally build from source with stable Rust (see README).

stats.cadence: frequent releases (v0.1.3 to v0.1.5 in 4 days)

verdict.why: Rare free Substance Painter-style tool that opens .spp projects; 122 stars in a week, active releases with binaries for 3 OSes, GPL-3.0 verified, 191 likes/186 bookmarks on the source post. Early version, expect rough edges.
